What Does a Whole-Home Humidifier Do?

settings.editor:
A whole-house humidifier works directly with your HVAC system to add controlled moisture into the air circulating through your home.

Unlike portable units, a furnace-mounted humidifier:

icon_list.text: Distributes moisture evenly throughout the entire home
Automatically maintains ideal humidity levels
Prevents over-humidification
Improves winter comfort without constant refilling

settings.editor: Proper humidity control keeps your indoor levels between 30%–50%, which is considered ideal for both comfort and health.

settings.title: Benefits of Installing a Whole-Home Humidifier

icon_list.text: Reduces dry skin and chapped lips
Eases scratchy throat and dry nasal passages
Helps relieve allergy and asthma irritation
May reduce winter cold and flu discomfort
Prevents wood floor and furniture cracking
Reduces static electricity buildup
Protects electronics from static damage

settings.editor: Moist air feels warmer than dry air, allowing you to lower your thermostat slightly without sacrificing comfort, which may reduce heating costs.
